name: Arvind Gupta Toys

curriculum.summary: Arvind Gupta is a toy inventor who makes science toys from waste materials. His website and YouTube channel share instructions and short videos for hundreds of toys, which he makes available without copyright restrictions. The site also hosts a large free library of children's books, mostly as PDFs, and he has translated over 290 books into Hindi.

fees_note: Free (stated by Gupta in a secondary source).
